title: To learn and practise at due times
shortSummary: The Analects opens by connecting learning, repeated practice and pleasure.
curatorialDescription: Xi retains space for review, enactment and habituation rather than becoming one modern study technique.
researchNote: Early commentary, Tang classical exegesis and translation variants remain to be added.

sources.title: Received editions and chapter references for the Analects
sources.locator: 颜渊第十二，第1章（“克己复礼为仁”）
sources.role: Initial basis for the Confucian passage and chapter locator

profile.modernZh: 学习并按时温习和践行，不也是令人愉悦的吗？
profile.translationEn: To learn and practise at due times—is this not a pleasure?
